description: Analog partition testbenches: (1) the characterization bench behind the committed TT/1.20V/25C Liberty view -- the pure klt characterize request builder, the runner that drives klt and appends the append-only evidence record (capturing the IHP-Open-PDK revision of the --pdk-dir checkout before anything is written), the freshness checker that re-derives the committed view's provenance claims, the harness modules they import, the netlist generator and the config every measurement is made from; and (2) the T1 item 5 klt sim corner testbenches (sim/item5/, #180 -- pure function/timing request and netlist builders, runner, and builder tests) covering spec row 9 at TT/1.20V/25C for the four committed cells. The attested cold start (sh sim/characterize/cold_start.sh) is honestly lighter than the full benches: it runs the characterization request-construction tests (python3 -m unittest sim.characterize.tests.test_request) and the freshness checker (python3 -m sim.characterize.check_library) -- both tool-free, stdlib Python only, and the checker fails on any stale or tampered committed artifact (config bytes, record, PDK pin, provenance stamps); the item 5 builder tests run in CI (python3 -m pytest sim/item5/tests). It does NOT re-run the SPICE characterization or item 5 klt sim sweeps themselves: those need klt, ngspice and an IHP-Open-PDK git checkout at the pinned commit (characterization recorded in documented_argv below and in README.md 'Reproducing the characterization'; item 5 in sim/item5/README.md). Later benches (klt pex -- issue #181) extend this inventory instead of adding a second one.
